items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: He was one of my children like the other children.

ctx.x: Tiny Kahn was a very good drummer.

You better believe. He was one of my children like the other children. I said, "You take it. I'm not going to get up at that time in the morning." Because you remember at the same time I was doing the thing with the Teddy Wilson show that you and I used to do every Saturday.
